props.name: role
props.description: How assistive technology announces the notice. `alert` interrupts; `status` waits for a pause. Beyond S2, whose InlineAlert is always `alert`.

props.name: children
props.type: number | boolean | RenderedElement | ArrayElement | (string & {}) | Node | JSX.ArrayElement

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Whether to automatically focus the InlineAlert when it first renders.

props.name: variant
props.description: The semantic tone of an InlineAlert. `success`/`warning` alias `positive`/`notice`.

props.name: fillStyle
props.description: The visual style of the InlineAlert.

props.name: styles
props.description: Spectrum-defined styles, returned by the `style()` macro.

props.name: UNSAFE_className
props.description: Additional CSS class name. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: UNSAFE_style
props.description: Additional inline styles. Use only as a last resort.

props.name: ref
props.type: HTMLDivElement | ((el: HTMLDivElement) => void) | { current?: HTMLDivElement | null | undefined; }
props.description: Ref for the root alert element.

props.name: class
props.description: Backward-compatible class alias. Prefer UNSAFE_className for S2 parity.
